after: Issue #533 -- one line a site manager keeps on this asset: what sets it apart from the others of its kind, or where it is kept. At most 50 characters, trimmed with runs of spaces collapsed and case kept, and blank where it has none -- the app writes null to clear it. Written, changed and cleared on the asset's page by a site manager on a job while the asset is In stock or Out (lib/assetStatus.js:MAY_WRITE_NOTE_IN_STATUS); read by everyone else, and while it is In repair or Retired. NOT AN EVENT: changing it appends no Asset Log row and moves neither Status nor Job, so nothing records who wrote it or when, and a category's list does not count it as a change. Not printed on the label. lib/assetNote.js holds the rule.
